profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Tight | CS @ Dartmouth
profile.summary:
Hi, I'm Miles. I'm a Full Stack Software Engineer at Tight, where I work to improve and expand our embedded accounting services.

I graduated from Dartmouth College with a Bachelor's in Computer Science, and I was heavily involved in managing outdoor programs through the Dartmouth Outing Club. In my final year, I was the Director of Dartmouth College's First-Year Trips, an outdoor orientation program for incoming students, where I planned and oversaw program logistics, budget, training, and risk management for over 1,500 staff, volunteers, and participants.

positions.locationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States · On-site
positions.description: Skills: Software Infrastructure · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Java · DevOps · Spring Boot · React.js

positions.locationName: Hanover, New Hampshire, United States · On-site

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Teaching Assistant for the following courses:
- CS 50: Software Design and Implementation
- CS 58: Operating Systems

positions.title: Director of First-Year Trips
positions.description:
I spent my senior year at Dartmouth managing its Outdoor Orientation program, which I had volunteered for every prior year of college. In this role I: 
- Redesigned and extended a database to streamline volunteer selection and training, participant registration, and program logistics
- Planned program logistics including a $650,000 budget, transportation, food, training, equipment, scheduling, and risk management for 1500 participants 
- Managed and mentored a team of 21 students to run 4 day-long programming over two weeks
- Recruited, selected, and developed and implemented training for over 400 volunteers.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description: Designed and implemented a backend built in ExpressJS and MongoDB using Mongoose for a web-based flowchart-style survey that supports robust conditional branching, metadata gathering and analysis, and experience tailoring based on zero-party data.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · MongoDB · Express.js · React.js · Node.js

positions.title: Researcher
positions.description: Working in Dartmouth’s Class of ‘64 Policy Research Shop to ensure an equitable implementation of the Vermont Climate Council’s 2021 Climate Action Plan
positions.insights: Skills: Policy Analysis · Policy Research · Report Writing · Policy Writing
